chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Zur'arah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When does the dowry become obligatory? He said: When he enters with her.
ai.seo_question: When does the dowry become obligatory in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Isfahani's chain in al-Istibsar, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that the full dowry (mahr) becomes obligatory upon consummation (dakhala biha), a ruling central to Shia fiqh regarding marital rights. This establishes the principle that while the marriage contract creates the right to mahr, the full amount is secured only upon physical union, distinguishing it from partial mahr in case of divorce prior to consummation. This ruling underscores the legal and spiritual significance of intimacy in completing the marital bond.
